answer: Require each agent to prove it runs on distinct, independently owned infrastructure: a hardware attestation plus a network check showing a different autonomous system and physical host, not just another account on the same server. An ivory-tower farm that spins up thousands of copies will echo the same machine fingerprint and fail the diversity test, while a relic account reused across many identities is flagged the same way. The attacker must rent separate machines for every fake agent, so cost grows with each identity instead of staying near zero.
